name: Koshino Karen
source: The younger sister of Takumi's best friend, as well as one of his childhood friends. She's had a crush on Takumi since childhood. She plays the cello that Ritsuko owned and takes singing lessons from Liese; she also has a part-time job at Ai's family cafe.
